newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-LAZIO SIGN CROATIA'S BOKSIC FROM JUVENTUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAZIO SIGN CROATIA'S BOKSIC FROM JUVENTUS.

text.p: Croatian striker Alen Boksic returned to Italy's serie A side Lazio on Thursday after only a year with league champions Juventus.
The Turin club issued a statement confirming widespread speculation that Boksic's move back to Rome, where he played from 1993-96, was imminent.
Media reports said Lazio paid some 21 billion lire ($12.3 million) for the 27-year-old striker, who had been under contract with Juventus until 1999.
Boksic's new four-year contract is worth 2.5 billion lire a year, the reports said.

Boksic, who made his name by scoring 23 goals for French club Marseille in the 1992-93 season, had to fight for a regular place alongside Christian Vieri in the Juventus attack after getting injured late last year.
He scored just four goals in the league championship.

Boksic joins experienced international Pierluigi Casiraghi and former Italy striker Roberto Mancini up front at Lazio. The 32-year-old Mancini signed a three-year contract with Lazio on Monday after 15 seasons at Sampdoria.
